newsitem.title: USA: ANTEC Corp, TSX Corp set date for merger vote.
newsitem.headline: ANTEC Corp, TSX Corp set date for merger vote.

text.p: ANTEC Corp and TSX Corp said Thursday their stockholders will hold special meetings February 6 to vote on a proposed merger of the two companies.
The pooling-of-interest merger was first announced in October. The deal, worth about $195.5 million, is expected to be tax-free for TSX stockholders when it closes.
ANTEC is a communications technology company, while TSX makes fiber optic cable and RF distribution electronics.
ANTEC shares were up 7/8 Thursday at 9-7/8, while TSX stock was up 3/4 at 9-5/8.
